summary: Adds an experimental local Antigravity CLI projection and updates provider hook compatibility for Termbrio 0.5.10.

changes.text: Added a reproducible local Antigravity CLI plugin projection from the shared skills, HTTP MCP endpoint and bounded activity hooks. This is experimental local support, not an Antigravity marketplace publication.
Registered and validated Claude StopFailure and PermissionDenied hook events.
Requires Termbrio 0.5.10 or newer. Native setup, plugin hook trust and tool permissions remain explicit user decisions; experimental AGY live acceptance remains incomplete.
